runners_data.name: Sea Of Doubt
runners_data.comment: A runner-up two starts back, a winner four starts back — solid recent form, though a sixth in between and a below-par fifth earlier temper it. Fourteen days on from a fair third last time out, and today's trip already covered, our rating of 99 has her mid-field of 18.

runners_data.name: Bryson
runners_data.comment: A promising second last time out suggests he's finding form, with the unseated and brought-down efforts either side looking more traffic trouble than loss of ability. Thirty days off but with today's trip already covered, our rating of 104 marks him out as capable; the blemish is he's yet to win in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Broken Ice
runners_data.comment: Three straight fourths show he's competitive at this level, albeit a few runs back, and a fair fifth last time out keeps him in the picture. Our rating of 105 places him among the leading contenders on figures, proven over today's trip, though 48 days off and a stable without a winner from its last 48 runners are the concerns, with him still without a win in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Small Bucks
runners_data.comment: A fair fourth two starts back is the highlight of a modest book that also includes a pulled-up effort and two unplaced runs, the latest of them last time out. Thirty-nine days off but with today's trip already covered, our rating of 98 leaves her mid-pack in this 18-runner field, still without a win in her last five starts.

runners_data.name: My Mate Tony
runners_data.comment: A modest recent sequence — unplaced last time out, pulled up before that, and no better than a seventh earlier. Race-fit after 11 days, our rating of 94 has him in the pack of this 18-runner field, still winless in his last four starts.

runners_data.name: Sneddy Eddie
runners_data.comment: A fifth-placed effort last time out is the highlight of an otherwise modest book, with four unplaced runs preceding it. Fit again after just 11 days and with today's trip already covered, our rating of 89 places him mid-field in this 18-runner race, still without a win in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Turkey And Ham
runners_data.comment: A winner three starts back, with a sixth either side of that success. An eighth last time out is the least encouraging, but eighteen days on and today's trip covered, our rating of 88 places her in the lower-middle of this 18-runner field.

runners_data.name: Trixaboutmaisie
runners_data.comment: Well held in each of her last three starts — a seventh two starts back, unplaced last time out. With 261 days now since that run, a big fitness question; proven over today's trip at least, but our rating of 83 leaves her second-bottom of 18, hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Centaq
runners_data.comment: A below-par sixth last time out undermines what had been a fair sequence, including a solid second four starts back. Proven over today's trip and only 30 days off, but our rating of 85 has him well down the field at 14th of 18, still winless in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Firstupbestdressed
runners_data.comment: A fair third last time out, a fourth the start before, point to some ability, though two unseated efforts in between muddy it. Sixty-six days off but today's trip covered, our rating of 91 has him mid-field of 18, still without a win in his last five.

runners_data.name: Sekakarma
runners_data.comment: A well-held ninth last time out caps a modest sequence that also includes a pulled-up effort three starts back, with a fifth two starts back the best of it. Forty-five days off and rated bottom of the field by us at 83, he's hard to fancy on this evidence, still winless in his last four starts.

runners_data.name: Gortmore Lady
runners_data.comment: A well-held ninth last time out caps a mixed recent book that also includes a brought-down and a pulled-up run, though a fifth some way back hints at ability. Only 12 days off and with today's trip covered, our rating of 87 leaves her mid-to-lower in this 18-runner field, still without a win in that spell.

runners_data.name: Volez Vous
runners_data.comment: A well-held ninth last time out headlines a poor recent sequence that also features two pulled-up efforts and two further unplaced runs. Thirty-one days off and with today's trip already covered, our rating of 83 has her well down the field at 15th of 18, still winless in her last five starts.

runners_data.name: Glenriver
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in each of his last four starts, an alarming sequence, though a lengthy 156-day absence may explain some of it. Proven over today's trip, our rating of 89 still places him mid-field at 11th of 18, but the recent book offers little to work with.

runners_data.name: Stormy Jenn
runners_data.comment: A fall last time out heads a mixed book that also includes a pulled-up effort, though a third three starts back shows there's ability there when things go right. Forty-five days off and with today's trip covered, our rating of 83 leaves her down the field at 16th of 18, still without a win in that spell.

runners_data.name: Kalsman
runners_data.comment: A win four starts back is the standout in a mixed recent book that also features a well-held ninth, with a fair third last time out the most recent sign of form. Thirty-one days off but with today's trip already covered, our rating of 96 places him mid-field of 18.

runners_data.name: King Of The Greys
runners_data.comment: Pulled up last time out, a below-par end to a mixed recent sequence that also features two well-held eighths, though a fourth-placed effort five starts back shows there's ability there. Proven over today's trip, our rating of 102 keeps him fourth in the weights here, though he remains without a win in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Pahlavi
runners_data.comment: Backs up quickly just two days after his latest outing and is proven over today's trip; our rating of 107 leads the race on figures. Recent form is modest — a pulled-up effort among finishes no better than fifth — and the yard is short of winners of late, with him still yet to win in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Mephisto
runners_data.comment: Won twice in his last five starts, but those victories were followed by a 5th, a pulled-up effort and a modest 4th last time out. Fit for a quick reappearance 10 days on and proven over today's trip. Ranked 6th of 18 on our figures, he needs to rediscover that earlier form.

runners_data.name: Nakassama
runners_data.comment: Runner-up last time out, a winner the start before, a leading contender at 4th of 18 on our figures. Fit again 16 days on and proven over today's trip. The main worry is the weaker efforts before that recent upturn.

runners_data.name: Ringdufferin
runners_data.comment: Yet to score in his last four starts but finished runner-up last time out, and a strong 3rd of 18 on our figures marks him a leading danger. Fit after a 31-day break and proven over today's trip. The concern is the moderate form further back in that sequence.

runners_data.name: Typical Thomas
runners_data.comment: Yet to score in his last four starts, without a finish better than 4th, yet he tops our whole field at 1st of 18 on our figures — a striking number. Fit again 18 days on, though that modest recent form is the obvious concern.

runners_data.name: Cozone
runners_data.comment: Won last time out and again four starts back, with a 3rd and a 6th sandwiched between — two wins in his last four. Fit after 31 days off and proven over today's trip, but only 10th of 18 on our figures for this grade.

runners_data.name: Ivybrook
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts, none better than 5th, and returns from a lengthy 198-day absence. Ranked 9th of 18 on our figures, he'll need to find a good deal of improvement fresh to trouble this field.

runners_data.name: Andys Flame
runners_data.comment: Fresh after 31 days, proven over today's trip and a winner within its last four starts — the profile behind our selection. Rated 118 and ranked 2 of 18 on our figures. The sole caveat is a cold yard, 0 from 48 in the past fortnight.

runners_data.name: Joya Del Mar
runners_data.comment: Won last time out and three starts back, with a 6th, an unplaced run and a 9th mixed in between — two wins in five starts but form that swings between smart and moderate. Proven over today's trip and fit after 31 days off, but only 15th of 18 on our figures.

runners_data.name: Tribal Moon
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last three starts, though a 3rd last time was his best effort following a 7th and an unplaced run. Quick to reappear 18 days on and proven over today's trip, he's rated a solid 5th of 18 on our figures despite that modest form.

runners_data.name: Eastern Wind
runners_data.comment: A win five starts back stands out, though her last two runs — a 9th and an unplaced effort — were moderate. Quick to reappear 11 days on and rated a fair 7th of 18 on our figures, but the yard is out of form (1 from 20 in the last fortnight).

runners_data.name: Oh Janey
runners_data.comment: A winner three starts back, runner-up five starts back, but well held in both starts since. Back from 61 days off and rated only 13th of 18 on our figures, she is hard to fancy here.

runners_data.name: Morell River
runners_data.comment: Second last time out, a winner the start before, and a winner again four starts back — two wins in her last five. Today's trip proven and fit after 37 days, but rated only 16th of 18 on our figures and hard to fancy at this level.

runners_data.name: Adaliz
runners_data.comment: Her last two runs, a 9th and an unplaced effort, are well below the level shown when winning three and five starts back — two wins in her last five overall. Fit after 37 days off but only 17th of 18 on our figures, leaving plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Boston Beach
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last four starts, with a 3rd his best effort, and has not run for 576 days — a lengthy absence. Bottom of our figures at 18th of 18, he faces a stiff task fresh off such a long layoff.

runners_data.name: Caher Roes Den
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last five starts, and the placed efforts — three straight 3rds — came before a 9th and a pulled-up run last time. Returns from a 455-day absence, proven over today's trip, and rated 11th of 18 on our figures — the long layoff is the query.

runners_data.name: Mickey Cohen
runners_data.comment: Won three starts back and has stayed competitive either side — a 2nd and a pair of 4ths. Quick to reappear just 2 days on and proven over today's trip, but only 12th of 18 on our figures with the yard out of form of late (1 from 21).

runners_data.name: Fabhcun
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last five starts, with two pulled-up efforts either side of a 6th and a pair of 5ths — a poor recent sequence. Fit after 45 days off, he's rated 14th of 18 on our figures and has plenty to find.

runners_data.name: Tolka Row
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last five starts, though a pair of 2nds either side of a 7th and an 8th show he's competitive on his day; last time was a pulled-up run. Quick to reappear 10 days on and proven over today's trip, rated 8th of 18 on our figures.

races.name: Downpatrick Racecourse Family Funday Supporters Flat Race

runners_data.name: Be My Fortune
runners_data.comment: A fourth last time out, an eventful fall before that, and a creditable second three starts back — some ability despite the mix. Fifty-two days off but clearly unexposed, he looks capable of better, still winless in his last three.

runners_data.name: Breezingwithdstars
runners_data.comment: A modest book so far — a pulled-up run among finishes no better than eighth — but with only a handful of starts there's still plenty of scope for improvement. Forty-nine days off and unexposed, he remains one to monitor rather than write off, still winless in his last four starts.

runners_data.name: Its Time For A Run
runners_data.comment: Just two starts to date — eighth last time out, seventh the start before — leave little to judge on. A 206-day absence adds to the doubts, but he stays open to improvement as an unexposed sort, still winless in his last two.

runners_data.name: Optical Illusion
runners_data.comment: Two starts, two pulled-up efforts, leave little to judge him on, though he has barely had a fair chance to show his form. Seventy-nine days off and unexposed, this remains a leap of faith on the evidence, still without a win in his last two starts.

runners_data.name: Poets Walk Paris
runners_data.comment: Unraced and untried in public, so there is nothing on paper to judge him against this field. Everything remains open on debut, with the profile likely to develop with experience under 168lb.

runners_data.name: Rememberwhat
runners_data.comment: A single start yielding a fair fourth offers an encouraging first sign without much to judge fully. Twenty-nine days off and clearly unexposed, there's room for improvement as more starts come, still without a win from that solitary run.

runners_data.name: Tis Well For Some
runners_data.comment: Unraced so far, with nothing on the board to assess ahead of this debut. The profile is entirely unknown at this stage, with development to come under 168lb.

runners_data.name: Seamy Appletart
runners_data.comment: A single start yielded only an unplaced finish, leaving little to judge from such a brief sample. Thirty-eight days off, he remains unexposed with scope to do better as experience builds, still without a win from that sole run.

runners_data.name: Payslip
runners_data.comment: Two runs, two seconds, is a promising skeleton of form that hints at ability without much depth to judge her fully. A lengthy 107-day absence and a stable currently without a winner from 45 runners are the concerns, but she remains unexposed and open to progress, still without a win in her last two starts.

runners_data.name: Loves A Laugh
runners_data.comment: Unraced on debut, so there is no public form to assess against this field. Everything is open at this early stage, with the profile to be defined by experience under 157lb.
